protocol.evaluationShift: seeded initial-position jitter +/-20; health fractions distinct from training; enemy HP/damage multipliers 0.85/1.15; obstacles use a different existing tree approach
protocol.stressMode: continuing enemies during response, explicitly counterfactual

rewardArms.causal: original reward without protection bonus in window; protection-only receipts write executed defense cue in built-in associative memory
rewardArms.terminal: original reward with victory/owner defeat/pet exhaustion terms doubled, clipped [-1,1]

protocol.promotion: held-out improvement >=5 percentage points; paired seed-bootstrap 95% lower bound >0; no scenario class worse than random by >10 points; checkpoint and isolation tests pass
protocol.selection: no tuning or arm selection from validation/evaluation; all predeclared arms reported
